Indulge in Grape Gas, a Indica hybrid from the lineage of OG Chem, Grand Daddy Purple, and The Truth, delivering a mix of mental uplift and physical relaxation. Its dense, chunky buds shimmer in deep green with indigo-purple hues, fluffy popcorn nugs frosted in amber trichomes and orange pistils, evoking strains like GMO or Gelato. The aroma bursts with pungent sour diesel, spicy grape candy, zesty citrus, and hints of berry, cheese, and chocolate, while the flavor delivers bold spicy grape, sour citrus, gassy diesel, and grassy herbal notes. Effects kick off with euphoric, tingly energy sparking creativity and focus, easing into a racy relaxation that blends body calm with mellow sedation.

A powerhouse hybrid cross combining Gelato #41 (Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint Cookies by the Cookies Family) with Grape Gas (Grape Pie x Jet Fuel Gelato by Compound Genetics). Gelato #41 brings a heavy, relaxing body high without clouding the mind. Grape Gas adds pungent grape notes with fuel-forward diesel punch and energizing, euphoric effects that mellow into soothing relaxation. Together: exceptional flavor complexity with a clear-headed, fully-body high.

Sweet grape candy meets floral soda terps with a smooth gassy finish. Grape Soda delivers uplifting euphoria, balanced body relaxation, and standout flavor — crafted for smokers who appreciate terp depth and potency. Terpenes: Limonene, Linalool, Terpineol, Beta-Caryophyllene, Beta-Pinene

Guava Blaze (also known simply as Guava) is a sativa-dominant hybrid phenotype of the famous Gelato #33 strain. Guava Blaze is highly regarded as a "get up and go" strain, making it a favorite for daytime motivation.

The scent that defined a city. Haze is recognized for its unmistakable aroma—spicy, incense-like, and deeply rooted in New York culture. This profile has floated through NYC neighborhoods for decades, becoming a symbol of an era and a sound all its own. Long regarded as a cornerstone strain, Haze is valued for its sharp, expressive character and unmistakable presence. A true staple with legacy appeal, this is the anthem that never fades.

Jack Herer, also known as "JH," "The Jack," "Premium Jack," and "Platinum Jack" is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that has gained as much renown as its namesake, the marijuana activist and author of The Emperor Wears No Clothes. Combining a Haze hybrid with a Northern Lights #5 and Shiva Skunk cross, Sensi Seeds created Jack Herer hoping to capture both cerebral elevation and heavy resin production. Its rich genetic background gives rise to several different variations of Jack Herer, each phenotype bearing its own unique features and effects. Leafly reviewers tell us that Jack Herer’s effects include feeling energetic, creative, and uplifted. However, consumers typically describe this sativa as blissful, clear-headed, and creative. Jack Herer was created in the Netherlands in the mid-1990s, where it was later distributed by Dutch pharmacies as a recognized medical-grade strain. Since then, this spicy, pine-scented strain has taken home numerous awards for its quality and potency.

Aroma: A dominant sour citrus and lime overtone mixed with fresh berries, dark cherries, and a subtle hint of earthy pine. Taste: True to its name, it tastes like sweet fruit, raspberries, and tart lemons with a rich, creamy, cake-like finish on the exhale.
The classic variety is a cross between California Sour and Lost Coast OG. Pungent, sharp lemon zest and sour lime mixed with a heavy, skunky, and fuel-like diesel funk.

Pineapple Express is a sativa-dominant hybrid marijuana strain made by crossing Trainwreck with Hawaiian. While this strain rose to fame on the silver screen in 2008 amidst the release of Pineapple Express, it is a real strain that you can find on the shelves of dispensaries across the country. Since then, this strain has become a favorite in the hearts and minds of cannabis lovers. Pineapple Express produces long-lasting energetic effects that you can feel right away. Pineapple Express is in the 20-29% THC and may make you feel buzzy, alert, and creative. The best time to smoke Pineapple Express is in the morning, afternoon, or early evening hours. In terms of flavor, this strain packs a punch to your pallet with bright citrus notes infused with pineapple and earthy pine, thanks to the terpenes of caryophyllene limonene and Ocimene.

Gelato 33, also known as “Larry Bird,” is one of the most iconic phenotypes to emerge from the original Gelato breeding work in California. It was created through the cross of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies, two cornerstone genetics of the modern dessert cannabis movement. The Gelato project is credited to Cookie Fam Genetics in collaboration with breeder Mario Guzmán, known as Sherbinski, who played a key role in developing and refining the Gelato line that produced multiple numbered phenotypes, including #33, #41, #45, and others. Gelato 33 quickly stood out as one of the most balanced and visually striking selections. This phenotype is known for its layered dessert profile—sweet cream, vanilla gelato, and berry-forward fruit notes, backed by subtle earthy spice and light fuel inherited from its Cookies lineage. The aroma is rich but clean, often described as more “ice cream shop” than traditional cannabis, with a smooth, lingering finish. Bud structure is dense and heavily frosted, with deep green hues, occasional purple accents, and bright orange pistils coated in a thick layer of trichomes. It delivers strong shelf appeal and a consistently premium visual standard. Gelato 33 has since become a foundational cultivar in modern breeding, influencing countless dessert-style hybrids and cementing its place as one of the defining strains of the last decade. This expression reflects that original Sherbinski-selected lineage and its lasting impact on contemporary cannabis genetics.

Permanent Chimera is a potent, modern hybrid cannabis strain that leans slightly indica, celebrated for its bold personality and layered sensory experience. Its buds are dense and eye-catching, often showing off deep green and purple tones wrapped in a heavy coating of frosty trichomes, with bright orange hairs weaving throughout. The aroma is one of its most distinctive traits—pungent and complex, blending a sharp, almost chemical “marker-like” funk with creamy sweetness, gassy depth, and occasional hints of fruit or candy. When consumed, the flavor follows through with that same intensity, delivering a strong, funky inhale and a smoother, subtly sweet exhale. The effects tend to come on quickly, starting with a euphoric, uplifting head rush that can spark creativity or elevate mood before gradually settling into a deep, calming body relaxation that can become quite heavy at higher doses. With THC levels often reaching well into the upper range, Permanent Chimera is best suited for experienced users or those looking for a powerful way to unwind, ease stress, or sink into a relaxed, end-of-day state.

We all got caught sniffing markers in school, but this is a much better way to catch a buzz. A complex terpene profile makes for a hybrid smoke with something for everybody: gassy, fruity, earthy, and floral, all wrapped up with medium-high THC. Experience depends on consumer, set, and setting. This was the 2023 Leafly Strain of the Year, developed by Seed Junky Genetics and released by Doja. The crew that named it was probably picking up the same sharp, gassy smell that we find in ours; not sure if the OG varietal had the same complex terpene profile that our growers coaxed out of these genetics. This is a full-spectrum experience, with fruity, earthy, and floral terpenes supporting the overall gassy qualities. Medium-high THC makes this a stretch for new consumers and a solid smoke for the more seasoned crowd. The effects will be a wildcard depending on set and setting; watch out for the myrcene if you're worried about couchlock.

Permanent Marker Description Indica Lineage: Biscotti x Sherb Bx1 X Jealousy F2 Prominent Terpenes: Limonene, β-Caryophyllene, Linalool After a whiff of this flower you’ll know exactly why this strain has earned this moniker. A rich candy aroma soaked in a gas will assault your nasal cavities the moment you lift the lid. Permanent Marker's funky, diesel stank lingers in your nose and slowly diminishes until all that’s left is a faint sugary aroma bringing to mind a floral spring breeze. The deep olive greens and midnight purple of the leaves make the already thin pistils almost disappear when held at a distance. Sandy trichomes fill every nook and cranny of these nugs, making them appear frosty and cold. These high density nugs shaped like blunt, rounded cones will benefit from being introduced to your grinder. The flavor is minty and mysterious on the pull, with a slight tongue numbing quality. Upon exhaling you’ll taste tar and diesel as if you just licked a fresh paved road. A cerebral buzz sets in hitting you right between the eyes and leaving your body feeling numb. Great for relaxation, creative work or just plain gaming. This strain is potent and it can start your day, or completely end it depending on your dose. Runtz x Sunset Sherbet is a modern dessert-forward hybrid that blends two of the most influential cannabis lineages of the last decade. It combines the candy-sweet, fruit-heavy profile of Runtz with the creamy, citrus-leaning depth of Sunset Sherbet, originally developed by breeder Mario Guzmán, known as Sherbinski, whose work helped define the foundation of today’s dessert cannabis category. Runtz itself comes from the Cookies family lineage and gained widespread popularity for its loud, candy-like aroma and vibrant bag appeal, while Sunset Sherbet contributes a smoother, more refined layer of creamy citrus, berry, and subtle earthy gas. Together, they create a profile that is both expressive and balanced. The aroma is typically loud and unmistakably sweet—tropical candy, fruit gummies, and ripe berries upfront, followed by a creamy sherbet backbone with hints of vanilla and light fuel. The flavor carries through in the same way, often described as dessert-like but with added complexity from its Sherbet heritage. Visually, this cross tends to produce dense, colorful buds with deep greens, occasional purple tones, and a heavy frosting of trichomes that reinforces its premium presentation. Runtz x Sunset Sherbet reflects the evolution of modern cannabis breeding—merging loud candy genetics with classic Sherbinski-era dessert structure to create a strain that is both flavorful and visually striking.

Sharpiez is loud, modern, and built like a marker-stained masterpiece a flavor-heavy hybrid that brings together the clean candy-floral weirdness of Zoap with the sharp, gassy dessert depth of Permanent Marker. One cannabis review listing for Sharpiez also connects the cross to Zoap × Permanent Marker and notes terpenes including limonene, caryophyllene, linalool, and myrcene. The aroma opens loud and unusual in the best way: sweet tropical candy, creamy fruit, floral soap, and a sharp marker-gas finish that instantly gives it attitude. Break the flower apart and deeper notes show up berry syrup, citrus peel, vanilla dough, fresh rubber, and peppery fuel. On the inhale, Sharpiez starts sweet and glossy, almost like candy-coated fruit with a clean floral edge. The exhale brings the Permanent Marker side forward: creamy gas, pepper, and a lingering chemical-funk finish that makes the flavor feel expensive and dangerous. Sharpiez delivers a balanced but expressive experience with a fast mood lift and a smooth mental buzz that feels creative, social, and slightly mischievous. It has that “ideas are moving faster than usual” energy without becoming chaotic. As it settles, the body gets comfortable and relaxed, giving the strain enough smoothness to keep it enjoyable from start to finish. Great for studio sessions, design work, night drives, playlists, or any moment that needs a little weird luxury. Visually, Sharpiez should look as loud as it smells: dense frosty buds, deep green and purple tones, bright orange pistils, and heavy trichome coverage that gives the flower that sugar-dipped exotic look. Sticky, aromatic, and full of personality, this is the type of jar people open twice just to smell again. Sharpiez is not here to be polite it is here to leave a mark.

Small batch cannabis refers to cannabis products that are created in limited quantities, typically by small-scale growers or artisans. This method prioritizes quality over quantity, emphasizing sustainable and organic cultivation practices. Small batch cannabis is generally defined by: Limited production runs: Smaller batches enable greater attention to detail and quality control. Artisanal methods: Growers frequently employ handcrafted techniques and nurture individual plants, thereby enhancing the overall quality of the product. Higher value: Due to the limited scale, small batch cannabis can achieve a higher price point, reflecting the dedication and craftsmanship involved. Environmental benefits: The smaller scale often results in more eco-friendly practices, such as reduced pesticide usage and improved resource management.

OG Kush, also known as "Premium OG Kush," was first cultivated in Florida in the early ‘90s when a marijuana strain from Northern California was supposedly crossed with Chemdawg, Lemon Thai and a Hindu Kush plant from Amsterdam. The result was a hybrid with a unique terpene profile that boasts a complex aroma with notes of fuel, skunk, and spice. OG often refers to “Original Gangster,” or "Ocean Grown" indicating either the strain’s authenticity or intensity. Many people have different names for the acronym, but real OG Kush should smell like lemon-pine-fuel with a high-THC, mixed head and body effect. It's often enjoyed in the back half of the day to ease stress. The genetic backbone of West Coast cannabis varieties, OG Kush arrived in Los Angeles in 1996 when Matt “Bubba” Berger brought it (along with “The Bubba,” which was later used to create the famed Bubba Kush) from Florida to legendary cultivator Josh D. Since then, OG Kush has become a worldwide staple used to create numerous famous strains like GSC and Headband. There are many different phenotypes of OG Kush weed, including Tahoe OG, SFV OG, and Ghost OG.

Purple Zkittlez is a slightly indica dominant hybrid strain (60% indica/40% sativa) created through crossing the classic Purple Punch X Zkittlez strains. Known for its gorgeous appearance and super delicious flavor, Purple Zkittlez is absolutely perfect for any hybrid lover who appreciates a great taste, too. Purple Zkittlez buds have gorgeous spade-shaped dark green nugs with deep purple undertones, dark amber hairs and a coating of thick frosty purple-tinted crystal trichomes dripping with sweet resin. As you pull apart each sticky little nugget, spicy aromas of earthy herbs and ripe blueberries are released. The flavor is very similar, although with a sweet berry candy overtone that tingles on the tongue. The Purple Zkittlez is just as delightful as the flavor, with full-bodied buzzy effects that will have you relaxing and totally aroused. You'll feel euphoric and lifted at the onset of the high, a feeling that remains from start to finish. A sense of creativity accompanies this lift, infusing you with a touch of artistic energy without causing any anxiety.

Super Boof is a zingy hybrid weed strain made by crossing Black Cherry Punch and Tropicana Cookies. It has the same chunky, deep green and purple-dappled buds as its parents that look wet with silver calyxes. The effects of Super Boof are relaxing and giggly. Reviewers on Leafly say this strain makes them feel euphoric, creative and focused. Medical marijuana patients say they buy Super Boof for gastrointestinal disorders, depression, and fibromyalgia. The dominant terpene is myrcene. The original breeder of the Super Boof strain is California’s Blockhead, who named it “Blockberry” in 2019. Michigan grower/influencer Mobilejay selected a variety and ironically named it Super Boof, popularizing it in 2021 and 2022. Super Boof consistently wins top honors in the flower and hash category, including back-to-back wins as ice water hash in The Ego Clash of 2023 and 2024.

This strain is prized for its vibrant lemon aroma that carries sharp citrus zest, sweet fruit notes, and a refreshing herbal undertone — creating a lively and flavorful experience from jar to exhale.

Tropical Flavors with strong notes of pineapple. This strain gives creativity and high energy euphoria

Neon Nights is a bright, uplifting hybrid bred by Exotix Genetics and grown with Boujee Ben quality. This strain delivers a smooth mix of sweet citrus, light herbal notes, and a warm earthy finish. The aroma opens with soft lemon and sweet fruit, followed by a subtle gas note and a clean pine edge. The effects are guided by its dominant terpenes. Myrcene brings a calm, relaxing body feel. Caryophyllene adds a warm, soothing quality that helps melt away tension. Pinene and limonene give the strain its fresh citrus and pine character while adding a clear, focused head effect. The result is a balanced high that feels creative, social, and easygoing without being heavy. Neon Nights is ideal for evening sessions, creative projects, or unwinding with a bright, happy mood.

Northern Lights can't promise that you'll see colors in the sky, but it can promise a wonderfully cozy experience. This high THC indica strain has notes of spice and citrus to put the mind at ease after a long day.

A powerhouse hybrid with bold aromas of dried berries, toasted nuts, and citrus. Its resin-packed buds deliver a tangy, flavorful smoke that hits hard yet keeps you in control. Known as the ultimate “work weed,” it fuels creativity, sharpens focus, and lifts your mood - perfect for getting things done or vibing through the night.

Pannacotta is a decadent hybrid strain known for its creamy, dessert-like flavor profile and balanced effects. With notes of vanilla, sweet berries, and a hint of floral earthiness, this strain delivers a smooth, flavorful smoke that’s as indulgent as its namesake dessert. The high offers a gentle cerebral uplift paired with calming body relaxation, making it ideal for mellow evenings, creative sessions, or simply treating yourself to a moment of bliss. Pairs well with: quiet nights and soft lighting, binge-watching comfort shows, late-night snack missions, or curling up with your favorite blanket and no agenda

Bred by Rising Moon Medicinals (Michigan) by crossing his Manistee OG with his Pine Sap Chem. The results are tight, pinecone-shaped buds with a robust terpene profile that ranges from Pine, gas, leather, tennis balls and OG terps. Lip-smacking smoke with potent effects. Cerebral stimulation off the bat that leads to an extremely relaxed state as the effects linger.

Poddy Mouth is a hybrid weed strain made from a genetic cross between Humboldt Pound Cake and Mtn Top Mint. This strain is named after its dazzling trichome covered bracts, aka pods, that resemble candy. Poddy Mouth is 24-30% THC, making this strain an ideal choice for experienced cannabis consumers. Leafly customers tell us Poddy Mouth effects include euphoria, creativity, and relaxation. Medical marijuana patients often choose Poddy Mouth when dealing with symptoms associated with chronic pain, stress, and depression. Bred by Humboldt Seed Company, Poddy Mouth features flavors like earthy, sweet, and spicy. The dominant terpene of this strain is caryophyllene

Purple Haze (Sativa): Nothing is more nostalgic than cracking open a bag of Purple Haze. One of the original non heart racing sativa's. Originating from Columbian landraces. Living Soil Indoor, Grown In Canastota NY

This one’s special. On first open, you’re hit with an aroma of complexity - something “different,” something that is unmistakably “old school,” a smell that you can only get from Thai (it’s “hazey,” but not), but also VERY blueberry. It translates almost exactly to the taste. The high is classic and nostalgic - dazed creativity, motivation, very stoney in the eyes, but uplifting and positive.

Rainbow Cookie , also known as “Rainbow Cookies,” is an indica marijuana strain made by crossing Sunset Sherbet and Animal Cookies . The effects of Rainbow Cookie are more calming than energizing. Consumers tell us this strain provides a dreamy high that makes them feel euphoric , happy , and hungry . When consumed in large doses, Rainbow Cookie can be sedating. Rainbow Cookie features a classic cookie flavor profile with notes of mint, berry and diesel shining through. The dominant terpene of this strain is myrcene.

Icey is prized for its dense, resin-coated buds and versatile effects that make it suitable for a variety of occasions. Indoor cultivation helps preserve the strain's terpene profile, resulting in flavorful smoke, strong aroma retention, and consistent quality from jar to jar. Rolling Hills Wellness is recognized for producing premium indoor cannabis with an emphasis on quality and terpene-rich flower.

Goonies captures a true sense of place and history. Cultivated by Treatment—whose cultivation roots date back to 1996—this flower is the result of decades focused on creating highly effective cannabis. Grown in the heart of the Catskills, it combines a deep respect for the craft with the rugged, natural spirit of the mountains. The profile is a wild contrast of childhood nostalgia and grown-up gas. It opens with a bright, undeniable Orange Cream sweetness—reminiscent of classic summer treats—before twisting into a heavy, complex finish of fresh tennis balls and burnt rubber. It’s a loud, distinct profile designed for those who chase unique, funk-forward genetics. The Science & Effect With a robust 1.12% Beta-Myrcene dominance, Goonies delivers the "highly effective" potency Treatment is known for. The deep, rolling relaxation mirrors the stillness of the Catskill woods, while supporting notes of Caryophyllene (0.31%) and Pinene (0.25%) add physical relief and mental clarity, ensuring you stay engaged while the body melts. Perfect For: • Lovers of "Gas" profiles with a sweet, nostalgic twist. • Connoisseurs seeking a profile with history behind it. • Those seeking heavy, effective relief for evening sessions. TAC 26.73% THC 22.64% Terps 2.36% Top Terpenes: Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Pinene

(Crippy X Triangle Mints) Cultivated by Treatment for Rolling Hills Wellness There’s a reason we call it YAAD. Born from a cross of the legendary Crippy and Triangle Mints, this small-batch craft flower offers more than just a high—it offers a destination. The profile features a crisp, sweet gas aroma with fresh floral undertones, driven by a dominant Limonene terpene profile that lifts the spirit without being overly sharp. But the real magic is in the effect. This strain is the definition of comfort, it settles in with a familiar, reassuring warmth that washes away stress. Whether you’re deep in the Catskills or just on your couch, YAAD delivers a centered sense of peace and the feeling of home, wherever you are. • Profile: Sweet Gas, Fresh Pine, Floral • Vibe: Comfortable, Centered, Uplifting TAC 36.6% THC 30.95% Terps: 1.97% Top terpenes: Limonene, Caryophyllene, Myrcene, Ocimene, Pinene

Sour Gusherz is a bright, candy-forward hybrid that leans playful yet composed — vivid, expressive, and softly tropical. Its aroma opens with sweet citrus and tangy fruit chews, layered over a subtle creamy funk that adds depth. The smoke is smooth and juicy, coating the palate with sour candy, tropical zest, and a gentle herbal finish that keeps it grounded. The high is calming but present — mood-softening and steady — offering a relaxed body feel paired with an easy, lifted headspace that makes it endlessly enjoyable.

Super Lemon Haze has a zesty flavor and aroma, with sweet notes that provide for a luscious smoking experience. This two-time Cannabis Cup winning sativa is a great choice for any time of day with a solid 28.46% THC.

Suspects Zkittlez is a classic strain with lemon, sharp pine, citrus, and spice notes. Trainwreck delivers a fast-hitting, uplifting experience with a strong, clear profile and a bold, unmistakable finish. Crafted and perfected by Peconic Growers.

Suspects Trainwreck is a classic strain with sharp pine, citrus, and spice notes. Trainwreck delivers a fast-hitting, uplifting experience with a strong, clear profile and a bold, unmistakable finish. Crafted and perfected by Peconic Growers.
Very even coasting hybrid

Nostalgia in a jar. This piffy, haze variety brings us all the way back to the beginning, going uptown to find THE Haze. Sticky green buds covered in red hairs. Earthy, churchy, dank incense aroma and flavor. A straight Sativa, this is the energy-driven strain that Sativa-lovers have been searching for.

White Choco Chip is a rich, dessert-forward profile — creamy, decadent, and deeply satisfying. Its aroma opens with smooth white chocolate, sweet cream, and a subtle earthy truffle undertone. The smoke is dense and velvety, delivering cocoa sweetness, light spice, and a mellow, nutty finish. The high is calming and immersive — settling the body into relaxation while maintaining a soft, clear headspace.
For the everyday smoker, White Widow is a keystone. Combining savory flavors of pine wood and earth with a floral finish.

description: Step into focus and flavor with Find Agent Z, a 14gpremium indoor sativa flower that’s built for energy, creativity, and good vibes. Known for its zesty citrus and sweet earth profile, Agent Z offers a smooth, aromatic smoke that keeps your mind sharp and your mood lifted. This full ounce is perfect for daily sativa lovers who want long-lasting supply without compromising on quality. Expect an uplifting head high, bursts of motivation and focus, and a flavor that lingers as bright as the effects.

Lineage: Bad Apple x Z Ambrozia by Connected delivers bold sweet candy and gassy tart fruit pie flavors with hints of pine and spice. Crack open a nug and you’ll be hit with a burst of sweet candy and tangy gas, balanced by subtle notes of pine and tart fruit pie. The buds are dense, sticky, and dripping in trichomes, flaunting deep greens, hints of purple, and a frosty layer that screams fire. These burn smooth with clean white ash, offering a silky smoke that hits just right.

Alien Labs Atomic Apple – Premium Indoor Flower Lineage: Triangle Mints × Apple Fritter Alien Labs Atomic Apple is a premium indoor flower with a bold, candy-inspired profile and serious character. Sour apple candy leads the flavor, layered with hints of fuel and a smooth vanilla cream finish for a sweet, gassy combination. Backed by Triangle Mints × Apple Fritter genetics and a high-testing cannabinoid profile, Atomic Apple delivers a potent, balanced hybrid experience with the premium quality Alien Labs is known for.

Lineage: South Florida OG × Gelato #25 Biscotti is a legendary indica-leaning hybrid created in 2016 from South Florida OG and Gelato #25. Originally bred as an evolution of the Gelato family, it has since become a standout cultivar recognized for its rich flavor, unmistakable aroma, and well-balanced experience. The flavor is deep and layered, bringing together notes of roasted coffee, chocolate, earthy sweetness, and a subtle gassy finish. Each batch can express itself a little differently, giving Biscotti a unique character while maintaining the profile that made it a modern classic. The effects bring together the best of both sides of the hybrid—an easygoing sense of relaxation paired with a creative, uplifting headspace. Smooth, flavorful, and full of character, Biscotti has earned its reputation for a reason.

Bomboloni (Sherb BX1 × Cherry Pie × Runtz) Bomboloni is a balanced hybrid with a rich, dessert-inspired profile that combines creamy sweetness with layers of cherry and candy. Smooth and indulgent from start to finish, it offers a velvety flavor that lingers pleasantly after each exhale. Flavor Profile: Creamy and sweet, with notes of ripe cherry, candy-like sweetness, and a smooth, dessert-style finish. Experience Profile: Euphoric and relaxing, beginning with an uplifting cerebral feel before gradually settling into a calm, soothing body experience.

Alien Labs Brainwash – Premium Indoor Flower Alien Labs joins forces with Talking Terps for Brainwash, a potent hybrid with a complex, layered profile and a distinctly cosmic character. The aroma blends herbal spice, bright citrus, subtle mint, and smooth sweetness, followed by a rich flavor that starts spicy and buttery before transitioning into sweet, earthy, herbal notes with a lightly tangy finish. Brainwash delivers a calming, sedating experience paired with a relaxed, wandering headspace. Potent without feeling overly distracting, it’s an ideal choice for winding down, easing into the weekend, or setting the tone for a mellow evening.

Lineage: Biscotti x Zangria Biscotti heads, this one’s for you. British Delight brings back that classic doughy gas from the Connected-era Biscotti you remember, with a Zangria twist that adds just the right amount of sweet. Think dense, dark, loud nugs that hit like they’re supposed to. The terp profile is hard to explain but easy to love, especially if you're chasing that now old-school Biscotti flavor with a little something extra. For real smokers only.

Mini Mart - Cake Face 3.5g Flower offers a rich, dessert-inspired profile highlighted by smooth vanilla cream, sweet cake batter, and fresh-baked dough. Subtle notes of warm spice and earth add depth, creating a full-bodied flavor with a creamy, slightly savory finish. Its indica character delivers a deeply calming, body-forward experience paired with a mellow, easygoing state of mind. Smooth and relaxing, Cake Face is well suited for unwinding, slowing down, and settling into a comfortable evening.

FIND presents Crusty Crustacean, a balanced hybrid flower that delivers a uniquely satisfying experience in every package. This well-crafted strain combines herbal, gassy, and earthy flavors that cannabis connoisseurs will appreciate. Perfect for those seeking creative inspiration and blissful relaxation, Crusty Crustacean offers a harmonious blend of effects that won't leave you locked to the couch or too wired. The balanced hybrid nature makes it ideal for daytime creativity or evening unwinding.

Take yourself back to the golden days of Sour Diesel, this sativa fires up with a thick, nostril-tingling blast of straight gas. It’s raw, skunky, and carries that unmistakable Chem-D punch, but with a smoothness that cuts the kick. The inhale delivers a sharp citrus bite, like lemon zest over pungent notes. The exhale settles into a deep, earthy fuel that clings to the senses with a tingly sweetness. This sativa is a full-throttle experience perfect for those who crave bold flavor and serious lift.

Lineage: (SFV OG x RC14) x Biscotti Gascotti comes through loud and unmistakable. Dense, spongey buds shine with a silvery, wet frost over layers of lime and forest green, threaded with rusty orange pistils. The jar opens with a sharp rush of mentholated gas. Crack a nug and it only gets louder, coating the senses with fuel-forward funk and a subtle creamy sweetness underneath. On the inhale, pine and kerosene hit fast with immediate lung expansion. The exhale softens into floral lavender and a light powdered sugar finish, where the Biscotti influence lingers. Heavy, wave-like effects follow. A euphoric head change lifts the mood before melting into deep, full body relaxation, making Gascotti an ideal end of day smoke for experienced consumers. Flavors: Diesel Pine Sweet

Godfather OG (Hell’s Angel OG × Triangle Kush) Godfather OG is a classic indica with a bold, full-bodied profile rooted in old-school OG character. Deep pine and earthy notes lead the way, complemented by bright citrus and a pronounced gassy finish. Rich, pungent, and layered, it delivers the unmistakable depth expected from a premium OG cultivar. Experience Profile: Deeply relaxing and physically calming, with a heavy, settling experience designed for unwinding and slowing down. Best suited for evenings or laid-back moments when a more tranquil, body-focused experience is preferred. Flavor Profile: Pine • Citrus • Earthy • Heavy Gas

Golden Trio (Lemon Tree × Grease Monkey × OGK) Golden Trio is a well-balanced hybrid combining three standout genetics into a rich, layered profile. Warm doughy sweetness leads the flavor, complemented by bright citrus notes and a smooth, earthy finish. Its balanced character pairs an uplifting, creative onset with a calm, relaxed finish for a versatile experience. Flavor Profile: Doughy • Citrus • Sweet • Earthy Experience Profile: Creative • Calm • Balanced

Lemon Icee (Lemon Haze × Jet Fuel Gelato) Lemon Icee is a bright, citrus-forward cultivar with vibrant lemon zest, sweet candy notes, and a smooth, refreshing finish. Its crisp flavor profile is complemented by an uplifting, clear-headed experience that feels focused and balanced, making Lemon Icee a flavorful choice with an energetic character and an easygoing finish.

Super Dope - Lychee Popperz is a candy-forward hybrid from Super Dope, bursting with exotic flavor. Bright lychee sweetness leads the way, layered with sugary candy notes, creamy undertones, citrus zest, soft guava, and a delicate floral finish. Light, tropical, and refreshing, its vibrant fruit-forward profile stands apart from heavier dessert strains. The experience brings an exotic uplift with a lively, social sativa current. Bright, vibrant, and unexpected—the drop nobody saw coming..

Indulge in a cosmic experience with Dark Heart - Moonbeam Gelato. This 3.5g pack of indoor-grown flower combines the smooth sweetness of Gelato with an interstellar twist of balanced relaxation and uplifting euphoria. Product Highlights: Effects: Relaxing, euphoric, and mood-lifting Flavor Profile: Creamy sweetness with notes of berry and earth Ideal For: Evening relaxation, creativity, and stress relief

Alien Labs – Permanent Shade – Premium Indoor Flower Permanent Shade crosses Permanent Marker × Nightshade for a heavy-hitting indica with serious potency and unmistakable Alien Labs character. Dark green and deep purple, tree-shaped buds are blanketed in frosty trichomes, creating a striking top-shelf appearance. The flavor is bold and layered, opening with subtle sweetness before shifting into sharp, pungent notes and a smooth, creamy, candy-like finish. The effects hit hard, building into a deeply relaxing full-body experience that can become heavily sedating and couch-locking. Expect the appetite to follow—Permanent Shade is known to bring on the munchies in full force. Lineage: Permanent Marker × Nightshade Flavor: Sweet • Creamy • Candy • Pungent Effects: Deeply Relaxing • Heavy • Sedating • Full-Body

LINEAGE Runtz x RS11 Rainbow Runtz is a stunning cross between RS11 and the iconic Runtz, delivering a unique blend of flavor and potency that makes it a standout strain. Known for its signature candy-like sweetness and unmistakeable gas profile, this strain offers a rich, smooth smoke that's both fruity and pungent. At Wizard Trees, we believe in the artisanal approach to growing cannabis. Unlike large-scale commercial grows that focus on quantity, we prioritize quality. Our cannabis is grown in smaller batches, allowing us to pay meticulous attention to every detail of the cultivation process. This hands-on approach ensures that each plant receives the care and nurturing it needs to thrive. Our cultivation process begins with selecting the finest genetics. Flavors: Lavender Sweet Coffee

Alien Labs Atomic Apple – Premium Indoor Flower Lineage: Triangle Mints × Apple Fritter Alien Labs Atomic Apple is a premium indoor flower with a bold, candy-inspired profile and serious character. Sour apple candy leads the flavor, layered with hints of fuel and a smooth vanilla cream finish for a sweet, gassy combination. Backed by Triangle Mints × Apple Fritter genetics and a high-testing cannabinoid profile, Atomic Apple delivers a potent, balanced hybrid experience with the premium quality Alien Labs is known for.

Now available in Claybourne’s Original Premium Small Buds — a selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from tried-and-true genetics. Always grown indoors and offered in a generous 14g format. A legendary pure sativa originating from the South African port city of Durban, Durban Poison is known worldwide for its distinctly sweet aroma and energetic, uplifting character. Bright and invigorating, the experience is often described as clear-headed, motivating, and creativity-forward — making Durban Poison a classic choice for daytime sessions, busy days, outdoor activities, or whenever you're looking for an extra spark of inspiration.

Bouket Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4) is a heavy‑hitting exotic indoor indica‑leaning hybrid known for its sticky resin, loud gas, and knockout relaxation. This cut stays true to the legendary GG4 profile—pungent earth, sharp diesel, and a deep piney funk—all wrapped in dense, frosty buds that showcase Bouket’s boutique indoor craftsmanship.

Hot Sauce is a lively sativa available in a value-packed 7g small-bud indoor flower, it brings the heat from the very first inhale. This lively sativa is all about big energy, delivering an uplifting cerebral buzz that sparks creativity, sharpens focus, and keeps you feeling motivated without weighing you down. Whether you're tackling your day, exploring a creative project, or simply looking for a mood-boosting smoke, Hot Sauce offers a bright, invigorating experience that lives up to its name. Its bold flavor combines peppery spice with bright citrus and earthy undertones, creating a smooth, flavorful smoke from start to finish. Cultivated indoors for premium quality and terpene-rich flavor, this 7g small-bud offering delivers the same vibrant sativa experience and potency as larger flower at an exceptional value..

Claybourne Kush Cake 14g is a soothing, indica-dominant hybrid known for its rich flavor and deeply relaxing effects. It blends the tangy, sweet, and earthy character of Wedding Cake with the cool, fresh mintiness of Kush Mints, creating a smooth and layered experience. The flavor profile combines sweet berry, bright citrus, earthy diesel, soft floral notes, and a refreshing minty finish. Kush Cake delivers an uplifting wave of euphoria that gradually settles into calming, full-body relaxation—an easy choice for kicking back and unwinding.

OG Kush has always been the king for us. From the flavor to the effects, no other strain delivers a true all-in-one experience quite like it. For a lot of people, their first taste of AlienLabs was through Mars OG or Lemon Fuel OG and with this strain, we wanted to bring that feeling back. Planetary OG is a nod to those classics the Jupiter OG, the Saturn OG, the Mars OG the legendary “Planetary” cuts that defined an era. It carries that same nose-stinging gasoline funk and heavy, euphoric punch that made OGs unforgettable. While they’ve long been labeled as indicas, we see them as the perfect expression of a balanced hybrid delivering both the cerebral and physical power that even high tolerance users crave.

Runtz is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through a delicious cross of the infamous Zkittlez X Gelato strains. Named for the iconic candy, Runtz brings on a super delicious fruity flavor with tropical citrus and sour berries galore. The aroma is very similar, although with a sharp spicy pineapple effect that turns slightly pungent as the sticky little nugs are broken apart and burned. The Runtz high comes roaring in a few minutes after your final toke, first hitting your head with a calming lift before spreading its tingly tendrils throughout the rest of your body. As the Runtz high expands, you'll begin to feel a deeply calming effect spread through your limbs, leaving you totally sedated and couch-locked, immovable for hours and hours on end before you finally fall into a deep and peaceful sleep.

A legendary Jack Herer x G13 Haze hybrid, XJ-13 delivers a smooth, euphoric high perfect for creativity and conversation. Its balanced effects keep you uplifted and clear-headed without paranoia, while bold lemon pledge and pine flavors make every hit a refreshing experience. A timeless classic with that Alien Labs touch. Flavors: Earthy Lemon Citrus Pine

Smoakland Strawberry Cough 28g brings the unmistakable character of this classic sativa to a convenient full-ounce format. Known for its bright strawberry-forward profile and uplifting character, Strawberry Cough combines ripe berry sweetness with fresh herbal notes, subtle earthiness, and a lightly spicy finish.
